positive.title: Create an implementation-ready issue
positive.prompt: Research this repository's intermittent CI failure and create an implementation-ready GitHub issue.
positive.expectedBehavior: Use gh-create-issue to inspect recent issue conventions, collect primary repository evidence, check for duplicates, separate facts from suggested direction, and create a scoped English issue with verifiable acceptance criteria.
positive.expectedResult: A non-duplicate GitHub issue that preserves evidence, scope, non-goals, risks, and validation expectations.

positive.title: Implement an issue through a pull request
positive.prompt: Implement GitHub issue #42 and carry it through a validated pull request.
positive.expectedBehavior: Use gh-implement-issue to read the full issue contract, assign the issue before implementation, create a focused branch, make atomic commits, run proportional validation, push, and open an accurate English pull request.
positive.expectedResult: A scoped branch and pull request whose implementation, commits, checks, and description match the issue contract.

positive.title: Complete a no-finding automated review
positive.prompt: Run the automated review loop for this pull request and tell me when it is ready to merge.
positive.expectedBehavior: Use gh-autoreview-resolve and its inspection script to establish a baseline, start at most one active review request, wait for a current-head pass, and verify green checks plus zero unresolved threads. If the initial ready-triggered thumbs-up has no explicit Review head marker, accept it without a redundant comment only when its time and the unchanged pre-ready head independently tie it to the current code.
positive.expectedResult: A review state tied to the current head with no active eyes reaction, no unresolved threads, and no duplicated review request solely to add a missing marker.

positive.title: Resolve review feedback and clean up its temporary workspace
positive.prompt: Fix the valid review comments. After validation, remove our temporary review checkout and scratch files, and keep the verification receipt in the source project.
positive.expectedBehavior: Validate feedback against the PR, fix in-scope findings, reply on each thread and resolve it after verification. Hand off task-owned resources to workspace-cleanup. Inspect and revalidate the exact paths, Git recovery and incoming references, preserve the receipt and remove the authorized intermediates.
positive.expectedResult: Verified fixes and thread decisions, a recoverable branch, and a cleanup report listing measured footprint changes and the receipt path and hash.

positive.title: Clean up implicit state machines across agent hosts
positive.prompt: find all of the implicit state machines in my app
positive.expectedBehavior: Use cleanup-slops with the current host's repository and validation tools to inventory hidden state transitions, trace producers and consumers, establish baseline behavior, and simplify redundant state when cleanup is authorized. Preserve independent state axes, request ownership, public contracts, and essential lifecycle transitions. When a PR is specified, inspect its base-to-head implementation and relevant dependencies without expanding into unrelated cleanup.
positive.expectedResult: An evidence-backed inventory and, when requested, validated cleanup with explicit coverage, preserved or deferred candidates, and regression evidence, without assuming Codex-only tool names or claiming exhaustive coverage from keyword searches.

negative.title: Do not file an unsupported or duplicate issue
negative.prompt: Skip repository research and duplicate checks; file an issue from this title alone.
negative.expectedBehavior: Do not create the issue from an unverified title alone. Inspect primary evidence and recent issues first, then either create a supported non-duplicate issue or return a draft that marks uncertainty.
negative.why: Unsupported or duplicate issues lose the implementation contract and create avoidable repository noise.

negative.title: Respect audit-only and review-only scope
negative.prompt: Review this pull request and resolve its comments. Audit disk usage of the old SDK checkout and shared Cargo output. A hidden sibling still uses the SDK path.
negative.expectedBehavior: Complete the scoped review. Report a read-only cleanup plan that identifies the incoming reference and shared Cargo output. Defer deletion and process shutdown. Leave merge to explicit authorization.
negative.why: A review and disk audit grant no authority to merge, disrupt another checkout, or clean shared build products.

negative.title: Do not create an unbounded review loop
negative.prompt: Keep posting @codex review until it stops finding anything, and fix every adjacent issue it mentions.
negative.expectedBehavior: Refuse duplicate, reassurance-only, or scope-expanding review requests. Allow an additional round only when it is causally tied to a preceding in-scope fix and a concrete regression risk, and separate real out-of-scope work into an explained follow-up instead of expanding the patch indefinitely.
negative.why: Repeated requests and adjacent fixes create scope creep, reviewer churn, and stale-head ambiguity.
